scope: Verified against the frozen arrival trace, full client log and receipt digests. Counter and CPC arms stay separate. Matched contrasts are reported without inferring independent N1 as paired N3.
budget_observation: Observed cut-ready-to-first-token includes decision, handoff, and worker/HTTP service. It is compared with the recorded policy budget and does not reconstruct future idle truth.
D_state: P-ready D quiet in this table uses the observed HTTP coordinator queue. The reservation receipt and Scheduler probes give engine-state evidence in the underlying trace.
D_actual_batch: Prepared step and decode query-row weighted batch from observed worker histograms. Forward time weighting is NOT_MEASURED.
D_reservation: Native overlap is the observed host interval from Native P-ready (occurring during another request's reservation) through its submit or reservation owner first token. The overlap bounds time; it does not identify incremental delay causally.
shadow: Shadow runs execute only full P prefill and Native D decode. Eligible decisions observe a policy and D state snapshot without taking its reservation. Actual transfer and clean timing stay distinct.
